text:
Maria: Quick sync — we need the final changelog snippet + docs URL for the launch post tomorrow 11am PT. Also need confirmation on canary timing and webinar slot. @Jason can you confirm model ids and rollback window? @Elaine can you drop docs link?
Jason: Pinged infra — canary starts 10:30am PT (30min), then gradual ramp over ~2h. Model names: rwd-v1.3 and rwd-v1.3-quant. Rollback window: 2h post-rollout. I'll paste a short changelog now.
Elaine: Docs link is live: https://docs.redwood.com/release/1-3 — added release notes and SDK examples. Still polishing the cost/perf blurb.
Maria: Great. Marketing needs: (a) 1-2 sentence changelog, (b) 1 example embed/snippet we can show in the post, and (c) a one-line benchmark highlight for the hero. Can we get these by 6pm PT?
Jason: OK — concise changelog: "v1.3 improves steady-state throughput with shared KV caching and introduces a quantized variant for 2–3x lower inference cost with <5% p95 latency regression." Example snippet: `model: rwd-v1.3\nprompt: "Summarize the following..."\n` Benchmark highlight: "~2.4x token/sec uplift on steady-state L4 vs v1.2 at 512 seq."
Elaine: I'll drop the benchmark table into the docs and add a one-line migration note. ETA 5:30pm PT.
Samantha: Webinar ask — can we schedule a 30-min pre-record + 30-min live Q&A at 2pm PT on release day? Need speaker list and a 3-bullet agenda to promote.
Jason: 2pm PT works. Speakers: Jason (runtime), Karl (bench), Maria (product). Agenda bullets: 1) What’s new in v1.3, 2) Performance deep-dive + demo, 3) Migration tips + live Q&A.
Maria: Sounds good. @deploy-bot — can you post the canary start/end in #release-war-room once scheduled? Marketing will hold social until docs link + changelog snippet are confirmed.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 1769920200 (10:30am PT); full rollout at 1769927400 (12:30pm PT).
Jason: Quick ops note — auto-rollback if canary shows >5% error increase. We'll monitor dashboard and ping marketing if anything deviates.
Samantha: Perfect — marketing will queue the post and webinar email but wait for the final changelog + docs link. Thanks all!
